question: As of August 2022, which Article of the Constitution of India says “No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Article 24 of the Indian Constitution expressly prohibits the employment of children below the age of fourteen years in any factory, mine, or other hazardous employment.
 
• This provision aims to protect children from exploitation and to ensure their right to education and healthy development.
